name: Rizuhble's Book Bomber Paige
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,000 (levels 1-14). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rallying Charge unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Express Shot. Ultimate (Rallying Charge) is available from Extra Spirit.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Express Shot completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Express Shot completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Express Shot completes 3,200 souls on. Upgrade of High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Express Shot completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Express Shot
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Bookwyrm (2 to 3).

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Compress Cooldown, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Compress Cooldown, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)
items.legacy_note: On Captivating Read.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,000-20,000 (levels 14-25). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bookwyrm T3, Captivating Read T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Bookwyrm, damage) grows from 150 to 313. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown, vitality 4.8k at Fortitude.

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 23.4 to Bookwyrm's damage (1.30x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Bookwyrm: takes 18% off its 21s base cooldown.
items.legacy_note: On the dragon.

items.name: Extra Health
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Fortitude completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Fortitude completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Bookwyrm (281), Captivating Read (202) clear its 80-damage trigger; Plot Armor stays under it.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Bookwyrm (3 to 4). Takes spirit from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Bookwyrm (313) clears its 165-damage trigger; Plot Armor stays under it. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,000-40,000 (levels 25-33). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Plot Armor T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Bookwyrm, damage) grows from 313 to 472.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Imbued on Bookwyrm: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +36.4 on its damage (1.30x scaling). Takes spirit from 10,400 to 13,600 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: On the dragon.

items.name: Grit
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Guardian Ward completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Guardian Ward completes 6.4k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Rallying Charge knight position spread (1.8m), Bookwyrm dragon travel range (32m), Captivating Read radius (9.5m). Takes spirit from 13,600 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 230s; 20% off is 46s per full rotation.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 24,000 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. | +30 spirit adds about 39 to Bookwyrm's damage (1.30x scaling).

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Greater Expansion.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Greater Expansion.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Bullet Resilience isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Mo & Krill's Combo.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep cancelling your ult.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: On the dragon. Sell Greater Expansion for this.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Sell Escalating Exposure for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Upgrade of Guardian Ward (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Guardian Ward.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Rallying Charge duration (13s), Rallying Charge buff duration (9s), Rallying Charge stun duration (1s). Replaces Tankbuster: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Longer root on your 3, longer ult stun and dragon trail. Sell Tankbuster for this.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Rallying Charge deals damage (damage), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage. Replaces Trophy Collector: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Sell Trophy Collector for this.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Fortitude for this.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 230s of base cooldown across your kit, 165s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Surge of Power: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Sell Surge of Power for this.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Bookwyrm: resets its 21s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Replaces Rapid Recharge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On the dragon. Sell Rapid Recharge for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Superior Cooldown.

sections.label: Optional swap / pivot
sections.legacy_desc: Their team has 2+ heroes who dash or fly (Shiv, Lash, Infernus, Vindicta).
sections.desc: Their team has 2+ heroes who dash or fly (Shiv, Lash, Infernus, Vindicta).

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Buy with Vortex Web instead of Mystic Burst.

items.name: Vortex Web
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Buy with Slowing Hex instead of Escalating Exposure.

items.name: Knockdown
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Buy instead of Surge of Power. It drops flyers into your trail.
